cumleler.metin: On the night of August twenty-first, nineteen eighty-six, a lake in the hills of Cameroon exhaled.
cumleler.duyulan: On the night of August 21, 1986, a lake in the hills of Cameroon excelled.

cumleler.metin: There was no fire. No flood. No explosion.
cumleler.duyulan: There was no fire, no flood, no explosion.

cumleler.metin: Just a silent cloud of carbon dioxide, rising from the bottom of Lake Nyos.
cumleler.duyulan: Just a silent cloud of carbon dioxide rising from the bottom of Lake Neos.

cumleler.metin: The gas was heavier than air.
cumleler.duyulan: The gas was heavier than air.

cumleler.metin: It flowed down the valleys, into the villages, while people slept.
cumleler.duyulan: It flowed down the valleys into the villages while people slept.

cumleler.metin: By morning, one thousand seven hundred and forty-six people were dead, and three thousand five hundred animals.
cumleler.duyulan: By morning, 1,746 people were dead and 3,500 animals.

cumleler.metin: Volcanic gas had been slowly building up deep in the water, until the lake could not hold it.

cumleler.metin: Today, pipes vent that gas safely, shooting fountains high above the lake.
cumleler.duyulan: Today, pipes vent the gas safely, shooting fountains high above the lake.

cumleler.metin: And just two years earlier, nearby Lake Monoun had done the same.
cumleler.duyulan: and just two years earlier, nearby Lake Monand had done the same.
